description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class for managing documents within the Fineract system. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, updating, retrieving, downloading attachments, and deleting documents associated with various entity types like clients, loans, and staff.

classes.name: DocumentManagementApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing documents attached to various entities in the system, supporting CRUD operations and file downloads.

methods.name: retrieveAllDocuments
methods.description: Lists all documents associated with a specific entity type and ID.

methods.name: createDocument
methods.description: Creates a new document using multipart form data, including file upload, name, and description.

methods.name: updateDocument
methods.description: Updates an existing document, optionally replacing the file.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Retrieves metadata of a specific document.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Downloads the binary file attached to a document.
